high.title: Savings Interest Rates 6/6: Latest Rate Table for Agribank, Vietcombank, BIDV, VietinBank, MB, Sacombank, HDBank...
high.summary: MBV currently offers the highest deposit rates in the market at 7%/year for all terms from 6 months to 18 months. PGBank and VIB also quote 7%/year for 12-month terms. The second tier includes banks with rates from 6.9%/year: LPBank (6.95% for 18 months), Bac A Bank, BVBank and OCB (all 6.9% for 12 months). Techcombank offers 6.75%/year for 12 months, while BaoViet Bank and Saigonbank both quote 6.7%/year. State-owned banks (Agribank, BIDV, Vietcombank, VietinBank) maintain 6.8%/year for online deposits of 12 months or longer. This interest rate environment reflects banks' continued competition for deposits, with rates remaining elevated compared to historical norms. For bond and FX traders, sustained high deposit rates indicate potential pressure on bank net interest margins and could influence SBV monetary policy decisions going forward.

high.title: Over 4.4 Million Customer Alerts Issued, Transactions Worth Over 5,000 Billion VND Suspended
high.summary: Deputy Governor Pham Thanh Ha announced at the "Smart Payments in the Digital Era" conference that the banking sector's digital transformation achievements demonstrate the industry's determination to pioneer a modern, intelligent digital ecosystem. The central bank aims to achieve 10%+ average GDP growth and increase non-cash payment value to 30 times GDP by 2030. The massive scale of transaction monitoring (4.4 million alerts, VND 5,000 billion in suspended transactions) highlights the sophistication of Vietnam's payment surveillance systems. This technological infrastructure strengthens financial stability and could support continued foreign investment confidence in Vietnamese banking sector. For VND traders, robust payment systems reduce operational risks and support the currency's international usage potential.

medium.title: Stock Investors Hold Their Breath Before New Variables
medium.summary: Markets are reassessing Fed policy expectations, shifting from rate cut speculation to potential rate hikes amid persistent inflation. Global risk-off sentiment on June 5 saw simultaneous declines in US stocks, Bitcoin, oil, and gold, while USD and US Treasury yields surged. This reflects investor concerns about Fed maintaining higher rates longer or potentially raising rates again.

medium.title: Vietcap Presents 2 Scenarios for VN-Index in June, Names Stocks with Positive Prospects
medium.summary: Vietcap sees Vietnamese market balancing between valuation support and positive international context, while facing foreign selling pressure and domestic macro concerns. VN-Index trades at P/E 15.3x, below 10-year median. Excluding VIC, VHM, VRE impacts, P/E drops to around 13x, indicating attractive valuations for selective equity investors.

medium.title: "Saying No" to Vingroup Shares, Billion-Dollar Foreign Fund Misses VN-Index Rally
medium.summary: PYN Elite Fund posted -2.64% performance in May 2026 while VN-Index gained 0.5%. Year-to-date, the fund is down 5% after 5 months, managing EUR 880 million (~USD 1.01 billion). The fund's long-term avoidance of Vingroup stocks may have contributed to underperformance as "Vin family" stocks often support VN-Index rallies.

medium.title: When Will Gold's Steep Decline Stop?
medium.summary: Historical analysis shows gold's major rallies typically followed by significant corrections. Current decline from January peak of $5,594.82/oz to $4,473.8/oz represents ~20% drop. Pattern suggests larger gains often lead to deeper corrections, with accumulation phases typically longer than rally periods.
